protocols.title: Protocols
protocols.empty: This study has no protocols yet.
protocols.name: Name
protocols.nameHint: The protocol's label for your team. Published versions are unaffected by a rename.
protocols.stepCount: {count, plural, =0 {no steps} one {# step} other {# steps}}
protocols.publishedVersionsHint: Published versions can never be edited or deleted. A participant enrolled on one stays on it for life.
protocols.stepKeyHint: The export column prefix. Stable across versions; lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
protocols.questionnaireHint: Only published versions can be administered. The same version may be used by more than one step.
protocols.triggerFixedDateHint: The cohort's start day. Combined with the anchor time below to give the instant.
protocols.offsetHint: ISO-8601 duration from the start point, for example P1D or PT12H. PT0S means immediately.
protocols.anchorLocalTimeHint: Leave empty for a pure offset. Set it for “every evening at 20:00”.
protocols.windowHint: How long the participant has to answer once it opens.
protocols.maxRemindersHint: Required. The cap is how you know what a participant will actually receive.

preview.title: Timeline preview
preview.hint: What one participant would receive. Computed with the same functions the scheduler will use.
preview.conditionalHint: A participant who does not complete {steps} never receives this step.

unresolved.PREREQUISITE_NOT_COMPLETED: Not reached — the step it waits on was not completed.
unresolved.PREREQUISITE_UNRESOLVED: Not reached — the step it follows could not be placed.
unresolved.PREREQUISITE_MISSING: Cannot be placed — its trigger is incomplete.
unresolved.PARTICIPANT_INITIATED: Started by the participant, so it has no scheduled time.

adjustment.SPRING_FORWARD_GAP: That local time does not exist on this day; moved forward.
adjustment.FALL_BACK_AMBIGUOUS: That local time happens twice on this day; the earlier one is used.

errors.PROTOCOL_EMPTY: Add at least one step before publishing.
errors.PROTOCOL_TRIGGER_DANGLING: A step is triggered by a step that is not in this protocol.
errors.PROTOCOL_TRIGGER_CYCLE: These steps trigger each other in a loop, so none of them can ever start.
errors.PROTOCOL_TRIGGER_NEEDS_OCCURRENCE: A step follows a repeating step without saying which occurrence.
errors.PROTOCOL_TRIGGER_OCCURRENCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: A step names an occurrence that does not exist.
errors.PROTOCOL_STEP_COMPLETION_OF_RECURRING: A step is triggered by the completion of a repeating step. A participant who misses one occurrence would never receive it. Anchor it on that block's start plus a duration, or on a named occurrence becoming available.
errors.PROTOCOL_DUPLICATE_STEP_KEY: Two steps share a key, which would merge their export columns.
errors.QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION_NOT_PUBLISHED: A step can only administer a published questionnaire version.

protocols.subtitle: A protocol defines when each questionnaire is offered, and for how long. Publishing freezes it.

install.title: Add the study to your Home Screen
install.whyBody: Adding the study to your Home Screen makes it one tap away, and on iPhone and iPad it is the only way notifications can reach you.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep3: Tap “Add”, then open the study from your new Home Screen icon.
install.iosStep4: Inside the app, tap the link below so it knows you are you.
install.androidStep2: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.handoffBody: Open this link INSIDE the app you just installed. It connects the installed app to your existing participation, and it works once.
install.handoffFailed: We could not create your link. You can try again from this screen at any time.
install.alreadyInstalled: You are using the installed app. Nothing more to do here.

handoff.title: Connecting you to your study
handoff.successBody: This app is now linked to your participation. You can close the Safari tab you started in.
handoff.failedBody: Install links work once and expire after a day. Open the study in the browser you enrolled in and create a new one, or use your recovery code.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.whyBody: Questionnaires in this study are open for a limited time. A notification is how you find out one is waiting, so you do not have to remember to check.
notifications.noContentNote: Notifications never contain your answers or any question text.
notifications.enabledBody: This device will let you know when something is ready for you.
notifications.blockedBody: Your device is refusing notifications for this study. You can change that in your browser or system settings, then come back to this screen.
notifications.requiresInstallTitle: Add the study to your Home Screen first
notifications.requiresInstallBody: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once the study has been added to the Home Screen.
notifications.requiresUpgradeTitle: Your device software is too old
notifications.requiresUpgradeBody: Notifications for web apps need iOS 16.4 or later. You can still take part — you will need to open the study yourself to check for questionnaires.
notifications.unsupportedBody: You can still take part in full. You will need to open the study yourself to check whether a questionnaire is waiting.
notifications.notConfiguredTitle: Notifications are not available for this study
notifications.notConfiguredBody: You can still take part in full. You will need to open the study yourself to check whether a questionnaire is waiting.
notifications.noGuarantee: Notifications depend on your device and network, so they can be late or not arrive at all. Opening the study is always the reliable way to check.
notifications.failed: We could not change your notification setting. Please try again.
notifications.permissionDismissed: You did not answer the permission request, so nothing has changed.
notifications.historyEmpty: We have not sent you anything yet.
notifications.reasonWithdrawn: You had withdrawn from the study.
notifications.reasonCap: You had already had the maximum number of reminders.
notifications.reasonNoSubscription: This device was not set up for notifications.
notifications.reasonQuietHours: It was inside your quiet hours.
notifications.reasonStale: The system was unavailable and it was too late to send.
notifications.acceptedNote: “Sent” means a notification service accepted the message. It cannot tell us whether your device received or showed it.

updatePrompt.message: A new version of the study app is ready.

push.initialBody: Tap to open it in the study app.
push.reminderBody: It closes soon. Tap to open it.

analytics.title: Monitoring
analytics.notApplicableHint: Nothing has come due for this participant yet. This is not zero compliance.
analytics.strictHint: The whole protocol as the denominator. Meaningful only once a participant has finished.
analytics.noDays: No windows have opened or closed in this period.
analytics.timezoneNote: Days are in the study's timezone ({timezone}).
analytics.question: Question
analytics.noValueHint: No answer. This is not a zero.
analytics.opsAlertsHint: Thresholds are defined once in the domain and are the same ones an external monitor sees.
analytics.opsNoSweepers: No worker has reported in. Scheduling is not running.
analytics.opsAcceptedHint: Accepted is not delivered. Delivery to a device is not observable.
analytics.noNumeric: This study has no numeric questions.
analytics.exportLongHint: One row per participant, step, occurrence and question. The authoritative format for repeated-measures analysis.
analytics.exportWideHint: One row per participant. Convenient for a quick look; long format stays authoritative for a long recurring block.
analytics.exportCodebookHint: Every question, option and code used in this export, plus the meaning of all seven missingness values.
analytics.exportStepsHint: The design, including which steps administer the same instrument twice.
analytics.missingnessBody: A blank cell can mean at least six different things, so this export never leaves you to guess. Every value is paired with a status column, and a value is present only when the status says ANSWERED. Nothing missing is ever written as zero.
analytics.missingnessWarning: If you see a zero, it is a real answer of zero.
analytics.monitoringSubtitle: Compliance across the whole study, and how each day closed. Figures never show a percentage without the number of participants behind it.
analytics.participantsSubtitle: Per-step compliance beside the overall figure, because one number hides the one that matters.
analytics.noParticipantsHint: Participants appear here as soon as they enrol with the study's code.
analytics.analyticsSubtitle: Descriptive distributions across the study. Percentages are over answered cells, and the number not answered is always beside them.
analytics.noDistributionsHint: Charts appear once participants have completed sessions containing choice or numeric questions.
analytics.exportSubtitle: Analysis-ready files. Long is authoritative; the others exist so a recipient holding only these files can interpret the dataset without access to the platform.
analytics.exportAudited: Every download is recorded with its format and row count.
analytics.opsSubtitle: Whether the platform's background machinery is running. An empty sweeper list means scheduling has stopped.
analytics.opsSweepersHint: A halted sweeper looks exactly like one with nothing to do; the heartbeat is the only evidence.
analytics.opsSubsLostHint: A large loss in one week usually means the VAPID keys changed.
